tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Courier Empire!
tutorial.welcome.text: Start as a courier and build your own delivery company. One delivery will teach you the basics!
tutorial.movement.title: Move a little
tutorial.movement.desktop: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move.
tutorial.movement.mobile: Use the joystick on the left to move.
tutorial.order.title: Your first order
tutorial.order.text: Tap ACCEPT on the order card. It shows the pay and time limit.
tutorial.pickup.title: Pick up the order
tutorial.pickup.desktop: Follow the restaurant marker. Get close and press E.
tutorial.pickup.mobile: Follow the restaurant marker. Get close and tap PICK UP ORDER.
tutorial.delivery.title: Deliver to the customer
tutorial.delivery.text: Follow the customer marker. The card shows distance and time left. Hand over the order at the door.
tutorial.reward.title: Your first reward!
tutorial.reward.text: Spend money on upgrades, gain XP for new levels, and build reputation for better orders.
tutorial.progression.title: Your next goal
tutorial.progression.text: SHOP has equipment. GARAGE has vehicles. COMPANY lets you start a business later. Find them in the menu.
tutorial.final.title: Tutorial complete!
tutorial.final.text: Deliver orders, upgrade your courier, and build your own empire.
